notes.title: V1.0.0 Update! We've officially launched!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44898504/4ea20eb1a310e14a26db1b17bb53935cfbced386.png[/img]
V1.0.0 has just now been released!
With this, Ark of Charon has now left Early Access, and has officially launched.
Thank you again to everyone who played during Early Access and helped us shape the game.

Below are highlights from the update, and lastly the patch notes.
I wish you all a wonderful journey through Ark of Charon!

[h2]Update Highlights[/h2]

[h3]Addition of the final stretch of the journey[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44898504/d45a9da2004d78d06a28a9c25430a56958bfefd1.jpg[/img]
The journey is finally complete, and you can now play through to the ending.
Gather new resources, face new enemies, and head toward the World Tree's nursery to bring new life to the world. What awaits you at the end of this journey…?

[h3]A new forbidden energy..?[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44898504/dc40cc80f103a56c6db312a1e423e496c34dd05d.png[/img]
Introducing the “World Tree Energy Extractor,” a device that allows you to harness a new form of energy. Along with this, several other related devices are also being added. These devices extract power from the World Tree sapling to fuel new weapons. However, using this device will slowly weaken the World Tree.

[h3]Evolving Tower Defense[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44898504/90f6e049be0dd5af37575624b6dfc4a446fc1bdc.jpg[/img]
New "wall-mounted weapons" that can be installed on indoor walls are being added.
These weapons, which can attack through walls and tiles while being shielded by buildings, will unleash a satisfying rain of arrows into the night sky.
In addition to the wall-mounted weapons, new weapons, enemies, and adjustments to game balance and enemy formations will make battles even more complex and engaging in v1.0.0.

[h2]Patch Notes[/h2]

[h3]Feature Additions[/h3]
[list]
[*]A new building has been added: the wall-mounted weapon. This weapon can be attached to the walls of rooms.
[*]A new building has been added: the World Tree Energy Extractor and its associated facilities. The World Tree Energy Extractor can be activated by placing it on the foundation of a World Tree sapling.
[*]The second half of the journey in Normal Mode has been added. This new area will not be reflected in existing save data, so you will need to start a new game to access it.
[*]A new boss has been added.
[*]Subspecies of regular enemies have been added.
[/list]
[h3]Feature Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*]A notification has been added when a mine has been depleted.
[/list]
[h3]Balance Adjustments / Bug Fixes / Miscellaneous[/h3]
[list]
[*]Overall combat balance has been adjusted.
[*]The conditions and probability for negative traits when generating Golems have been changed.
[*]CPU processing has been further optimized.
[*]New BGM for rocky and snowy areas has been added.
[*]Effects have been adjusted.
[*]Visual representation of underground and background elements has been partially changed.
[*]Other minor fixes and adjustments have been made.
[/list]

notes.title: Leaving Early Access Soon
notes.notes:
Hello hello.
Today's news is a little bittersweet.
We started Early Access with a plan in place to finish creating the game, but also a lot of hope for what we could achieve beyond that plan. 
We still have a lot of ideas and things we want to try with Ark of Charon that's been growing and growing with your feedback.  
But we have to and want to have a cutoff point for Early Access development where we can be sure to be able deliver a fully finished game. Realistically, we believe that point is about now.
So we are leaving Early Access soon, sometime next month.

There is some disappointment there, of things we really wanted to deliver to you but couldn't, but we have been keeping busy cramming in as much content and improvements we could in the time that we have. 
I am really excited and happy to deliver version 1.0.0 to you all next month!
I am also hopeful, that with the boost from officially launching, we will do well and sell well and we can continue development and keep updating the game.

But before we share what you can look forward to in version 1.0.0 (look out for our next post!), I'd like to thank everyone who participated in our Early Access, took the time to leave us feedback or did our player survey.
It was all immensely helpful to us in shaping our game, and keeping us motivated and inspired throughout.
Releasing a game this way was a new experience for our team, so it's been a really valuable learning experience for us.

We especially enjoyed going through the player survey answers.
When we did that survey, we were a bit more hopeful of the future. Some of the plans we made from the results, we've had to pause development for now. So again, it is a bit bittersweet, but I'd still like to share some of the results with you.
[list]
[*]We had 238 submissions in total.
[*]Most wanted new game mode was an endless mode with 36% out of 6 main choices
[*]Most wanted new content was a growth system for Golems with 39% out of 12 main choices 
[*]For most wanted improvement, it was Golem AI with 23% out of 12 main choices
[*]Game satisfaction average was a 3.98 out of 5
[/list] 

Thank you again to all who took the time to answer the survey!

And thank you again to everyone who has been with us through Early Access!
It's been a great journey!

Stay tuned for more news on v1.0.0👀

notes.title: 0.8.8 QoL Update: Food Restrictions and more!
notes.notes:
Hello hello.
We've got a new update up today!
Mostly QoL features and bug fixes, but there's some interesting things there.

First off, finally we have a food restriction features. Thank you to everyone who's requested this!

Also, we've decided to let you do something interesting...you can now actually choose to go back left on the World Map! Only in Normal Mode for now. Please let us know how you feel about this new feature, and how it affected the game for you.

And another one that's important but a little less glamorous...we've got a fix in for performance issues that can start from around mid-game, that should be quite effective! We'll keep working on this though. If you were having trouble with slow performance and this update didn't help things at all, please let us know.

Oh, and thank you so much to everyone who has participated in our Player Survey so far!
Please note that all the changes in today's update were decided on prior to the survey.
And if you haven't done the survey yet, and feel up for it, please do!
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2827810/view/4578560647861436200]https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2827810/view/4578560647861436200[/url]

Here's the patch notes:
[h3]New Features[/h3]
[list]
[*]Added a meal restriction function. You can now prioritize or ban specific meals for each Golem.
[*]In Normal Mode, you can now move leftwards on the World Map.
[*]Changed the sizes of two types of titanium rooms. The size of existing built rooms in saved data will remain unchanged.
[*]Added a Tutorial Notes feature to the pause menu. You can now review all tutorial content there.
[/list]
[h3]Feature Updates[/h3]
[list]
[*]Changed the priority so that Golems doing priority commands will still eat when they are hungry.
[*]When in a certain command mode, information was added to appear near the mouse cursor to indicate the current mode.
[*]Added supplementary explanations to each filter UI.
[*]Added tooltips to each UI, which can be toggled on or off in the Options menu.
[*]Enabled camera movement by moving the mouse cursor to the edge of the screen. This feature can be toggled on or off from the options.
[*]When there is an targeted location or characters regarding an event that occured within the colony are displayed, you can now click on the message to move the camera to them.
[*]Added crop descriptions when setting up agricultural zones.
[*]Now shows the size of the area being dragged when issuing mining commands.
[/list] 
[h3]Balance Adjustments / Bug Fixes / Others[/h3]
[list]
[*]Added an additional animation that plays after the opening movie. This is only shown during a new game. 
[*]Adjusted the combat balance in Roguelike Mode.
[*]Changed the final boss’s specific attack behavior so it can now be blocked by defensive facility barriers.
[*]Optimized the game, especially in the mid-to-late stages. We will continue to optimize.
[*]Adjusted the UI layout to improve visibility.
[*]Updated the tutorial videos.
[*]Added durability information to weapon descriptions.
[*]Made various other minor fixes and adjustments.
[/list]

Thank you!

notes.title: v0.8.5 Content Update and Sale!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44898504/675551609780036c7eb1a6e64dd84847675bd650.jpg[/img]
Hello hello! 
I’m very excited to finally have this content update up for you all, and to commemorate, we’ll also have the game on sale for a week!

There’s a new game mode that we’re excited for you to try; the Rogue-like Mode.
It’s a little more fast paced than the normal mode, and also higher in difficulty when you first start out. However! You can earn points from each of your runs, and level up your colony for your next runs. Do try it out, and tell us how it goes.

Also, we’ve added a lot of QoL content additions, fixes, adjustments and improvements.
Your feedback has helped in shaping pretty much every aspect of this and we’re continuously thankful for that.

Full notes for the update below:

■ Feature Additions
[list]
[*]Added a new game mode, "Roguelike Mode." You can select this mode by switching modes on the title screen. In this mode, you can earn two types of points based on your journey, which can be used to enhance your colony or select initial resources.
[*]Added new buildings: "Storage Tile" and "Compressed Packing Tile." These tiles increase the amount of items that can be stored.
[*]Added new buildings: "Fully Automatic Cooker" and "Canned Food Machine."
[*]Added four new room types and changed the sizes of three existing room types. However, the sizes of already-built rooms saved in previous data will not change.
[*]Added a priority command feature. Tasks with specified priorities will be executed preferentially.
[*]Added mission-style guidance to the tutorial.
[*]Added three new food items: "Salad Bowl," "Cornbread," and "Tomato Lettuce Sauté."
[/list]
■ Feature Improvements
[list]
[*]Added item descriptions to the manufacturing menu.
[*]Manufacturing settings are retained when moving manufacturing facilities.
[*]You can now view the information of the current area on the world map.
[*]Added the ability to reset priority settings in the priority settings screen.
[*]Changed the probability of negative traits in summoned minions created using multiple souls to be less than 100%. The frequency of stronger negative traits has been reduced.
[*]Changed the appearance of stocked item boxes for better visibility.
[*]Added display of construction strength and weight when hovering the mouse cursor over structural buildings.
[*]Adjusted the color of the construction strength filter to make changes in low construction strength more visible.
[*]Allowed removal and reinstallation of "Bomb Stones" and "TNT." These actions are performed faster than other buildings.
[*]Added a removal command to the action menu button at the bottom right of the screen.
[*]Added a feature to choose whether to use removed items when building from the construction menu. When this feature is ON, removed items will be used preferentially when issuing construction commands. This feature is ON by default.
[*]Changed the processing of high-altitude damage bonuses for weapons. For all weapons, the chance of critical damage will increase when placed at a higher position, though the increase rate varies by weapon. Critical damage is displayed in yellow text.
[*]Added "Hatch" to room ceilings, which can be installed from the underside with a ladder, allowing passage.
[/list]
■ Balance Adjustments / Bug Fixes / Others
[list]
[*]Adjusted item stack numbers with the introduction of "Storage Tile" and "Compressed Tile."
[*]Reduced repair time.
[*]Increased the effect duration of cooking buffs:
100→150 seconds: "Baked Apple," "Bread," "Baked Tomato," "Baked Lettuce," "Baked Sweet Potato"
100→300 seconds: "Apple Pie," "Pizza"
[*]Fixed issue where "Multi-Missile Launcher" ammunition was not displayed in the "Processing Table" and "Workbench" manufacturing menus.
[*]Adjusted the final boss’s attack behavior which was stronger than planned.
[*]Shortened the overall shooting interval for weapons.
[*]Increased attack power of late-game weapons.
[*]Increased power consumption for power-requiring weapons.
[*]Adjusted the overall amount of souls obtained.
[*]Increased overall building strength. Late-game buildings now have higher building strength.
[*]Adjusted the time required for mining.
[*]Expanded the lighting range of "Torches," "Wall-mounted Torches," and "Lamps."
[*]Increased the required materials for "Bomb Stones."
[*]Reduced the required materials for "TNT."
[*]Increased the charging capacity of "Coal Generators," "Wind Turbines," and "Solar Panels."
[*]Changed default settings for shortcut keys due to the addition of removal and priority commands.
[*]Fixed issue where having many items caused performance issues. We will continue to address performance concerns.
[*]Fixed issue where weapons would sometimes shoot in a direction different from the target when targeting the next enemy.
[*]Fixed issue where building commands would not proceed midway.
[*]Fixed issue where rooms built on pillars became inaccessible.
[*]Fixed issue where the shooting angle of "CIWS: Burst Custom" was too narrow.
[*]Fixed issue where minions would unintentionally stop doing anything when hunger state persisted for too long.
[*]Fixed issue where "Flak Cannon" ammunition was not displayed in the "Simple Workbench" manufacturing menu.
[*]Fixed issue where the accuracy of manual shooting with "Tron Accelerator" was not corrected.
[*]Made various minor fixes and adjustments.
[/list]

notes.title: Ark of Charon is perfect if you want a challenge, but needs polish
notes.notes:
In Ark of Charon, the tree of life has been consumed by darkness, and as it died, so too did the world around it. Golems, little goblin-like beings, tend to a newly emerged ray of hope; a seedling mounted on the back of a giant, walking tree creature. But the darkness that killed the tree is still out there, hunting the sprout, so the creature can only rest a while before it needs to move on, outrunning the dark storm. Tranquil base building and intense tower defense combine like the crests and troughs of an ocean wave. In the longer, calmer sections, Ark of Charon is a competent but uninspiring base building game. In the shorter, chaotic combat phases, it's fiendishly difficult, adding a layer of challenge that drives the game forward but soon proves overwhelming.

Read the rest of the story...

notes.title: Unique new city builder with an amazing twist is available to play now
notes.notes:
A lot of the times when I play city or colony builders, I eventually get bored of my surroundings. Sure, it's wonderful to see a small town turn into a bustling metropolis, but the hills and the scenery rarely change - Cities Skylines 2 is gorgeous, but it's still, throughout all my trials and tribulations, just a city. Well, in Ark of Charon, a new builder that you can play now, you have to pick up your settlement and move onto a new area every few days. You also carry your entire city on the back of a giant creature.

Read the rest of the story...

notes.title: Ark of Charon demo release!
notes.notes:
The demo for Ark of Charon has been released!
We're so very excited and happy that we get to have you actually play with the game for the first time. 
If you have any feedback or problems, please let us know through the Steam community hub which we will be actively monitoring, or any of our other outlets.

<Apologies regarding the delay>
Regarding the release time for the demo, we had announced in a press release that the demo would be released 9:00 AM PT of 2024/05/30. Due to mistakes in setting up the release, the release time was delayed to 13:00 PM PT of 2024/05/30, causing some to wait without news from us. We sincerely apologize for this mistake, and our delay in fixing the problem.

notes.title: New strategy game is a city builder atop a living World Tree sapling
notes.notes:
Blending the base-building colony sim stylings of Rimworld and Dwarf Fortress with tower defense elements and the cozy vibes of games such as Spiritfarer, new Steam strategy game Ark of Charon sees you building a city of caretakers atop the back of a young, beast-like World Tree sapling. Guide it safely to its destination to restore balance to a damaged, post-apocalyptic world on the brink of disaster, holding off the evil forces that would see that vision of chaos to its terrible conclusion.

Read the rest of the story...

notes.title: Build a mobile fortress on the back of a walking tree in colony survival game Ark of Charon
notes.notes: n upcoming colony sim will merge itself with the tower defense genre. In Ark of Charon you're in charge of building a fortress on the back of the walking sapling of the world tree as it travels to where it will grow—all the while defending it from the hordes of monsters that attack at every turn...
